try: Open the search from the side navigation
how:
1. Press "Search" at the top of the side navigation
2. Read what it offers before you type
3. Press Esc
expect: A panel opens beside the navigation with the cursor in its field. Before you type it offers "Go to" — Leads, Tasks, Quotes, Contracts, AI Visualizer, Templates, Studio and Keyboard shortcuts. Esc closes it.

how:
1. Open the search and type "sophia"
2. Read the Leads group
3. Press ↵
expect: Sophia Wong comes first under Leads with the lead's phone, property type, source and stage; the letters you typed are marked in purple. ↵ opens the lead, and its Back arrow returns to the page you searched from.

try: Find a lead by phone number
how:
1. Open the search and type the first four digits of Sophia's mobile
2. Type them again with a space in the middle
expect: Sophia's lead comes up both times — spaces and a +65 don't matter; the digits you typed are marked in the phone number.

try: Find a quote by its number, with the keyboard only
how:
1. Press ⌘K (Ctrl K on Windows) on any page
2. Type "OM-" and the first digits of Sophia's quote number
3. Move with ↓ and ↑, then press ↵
expect: ⌘K opens the search from any page. Quotes show their number, the lead and the total, with their status; Quote X-Ray readings of that quote show under Quote X-Ray. ↓ ↑ move the highlight, ↵ opens the quote.

try: Look in one kind of record only
how:
1. Open the search and type "kitchen"
2. Press "Show all …" under a group that has more
3. Press "All", then "Tasks" in the row of chips
expect: Under All each group shows its best few and says how many there are; "Show all n in …" switches to that kind. A chip shows only that kind of record.

try: Open a note, a Price book item and a material from the search
how:
1. Search a few words from one of Sophia's notes and open it
2. Search "vinyl" and open the Price book item
3. Search "oak" and open the material
expect: Each opens on the thing you picked — the note selected in Notes & Logs, the Price book item's dialog, the material's dialog — not just the list it lives in.

try: Come back to what you searched
how:
1. Open the search again
2. Read "Recent searches" and "Recently opened"
3. Remove one recent search with its ✕
expect: Each opening starts with an empty field; your last searches and the records you opened from here are listed, and ✕ removes a search from the list.

how:
1. Open the search and type "zzqq"
2. Choose the "Tasks" chip, then "Search everything"
expect: It says nothing matches, with a hint of what it can find; in a narrowed search "Search everything" goes back to All.

try: A designer only finds what they may see
how:
1. In Settings › Lead management set "Who sees leads" to each member's own leads
2. View as Sarah and search for a lead Sarah isn't on
3. Search for one of Sarah's leads; set Who sees leads back as it was and View as Dane again
expect: Only the leads Sarah may see come up — with their quotes, contracts, tasks, notes and files; nothing else does.

how:
1. On your phone, press the magnifier at the top of the screen
2. Type "sophia" and tap the lead
expect: The search opens as a sheet from the bottom with its field on top and the same groups; tapping a result opens it.
